verdict.rationale: Database Webhooks let users hook INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE table events to automatic HTTP requests, including to Edge Functions, built on triggers via pg_net. Supabase Cron adds time-based rules that run SQL, database functions, or HTTP calls, and Queues provide durable background task handling. Missing for 10: event sources beyond table row changes (e.g. auth or storage events) are not evidenced, no documented agent-native way to author these rules, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
